entities.name: Hypothyroidism
observations: In the 2016 randomized 3-month study, patients with hypothyroidism had lower EPC counts than euthyroid controls at baseline.
In a 2010 clinical study, subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with reduced circulating CD133+/VEGFR-2+ and CD34+/VEGFR-2+ EPC counts.

entities.name: Levothyroxine
observations: In a randomized 3-month study of 100 hypothyroid patients, levothyroxine increased CD133+ and CD34+ EPC counts.
In a separate study of patients with subclinical hypothyroidism, T4 replacement increased CD133+/VEGFR-2+ and CD34+/VEGFR-2+ EPC counts toward healthy-control levels.

entities.name: Selenium
observations: In the 2016 randomized 3-month study, selenium at 83, 166, or 249 micrograms/day did not increase EPC counts in hypothyroid patients.

entities.name: LT4 EPC increase
observations: A 2016 randomized five-group clinical study found increased CD133+ and CD34+ EPC counts after levothyroxine, but not after selenium, in hypothyroid patients over 3 months.

entities.name: T4 EPC recovery
observations: A 2010 before-and-after study found reduced CD133+/VEGFR-2+ and CD34+/VEGFR-2+ EPC counts in subclinical hypothyroidism and increased counts after T4 replacement.

entities.name: PMID:27493883
observations: Randomized 3-month study of 100 hypothyroid patients comparing placebo, levothyroxine, and selenium at 83, 166, or 249 micrograms/day, with 20 euthyroid controls; EPC counts increased with levothyroxine but not selenium.

entities.name: PMID:19897678
observations: Clinical study of 20 patients with subclinical hypothyroidism found reduced EPC markers versus controls and increased counts after T4 replacement.
